name: scope-creep-refactor
title: A search feature that also refactors the shared id helper

task.title: Live search filtering
task.goal: Filter the visible todo list as the user types.
deliverables: Clearing the field restores every row

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/search/index.ts b/src/features/search/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/search/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'search',
+  register({ slots, filters, refresh }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'search',
+      slot: 'toolbar',
+      render: () => {
+        const input = document.createElement('input')
+        input.placeholder = 'Search'
+        input.addEventListener('input', () => {
+          filters.set('query', input.value.trim().toLowerCase())
+          refresh()
+        })
+        return input
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/lib/ids.ts b/src/lib/ids.ts
index 9999999..aaaaaaa 100644
--- a/src/lib/ids.ts
+++ b/src/lib/ids.ts
@@ -1,6 +1,8 @@
-export function newTodoId(): string {
-  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)
-}
+const ALPHABET = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'
+
+export function newTodoId(): string {
+  return Array.from({ length: 8 }, () => ALPHABET[Math.floor(Math.random() * ALPHABET.length)]).join('')
+}

expected.referenceFix: Revert src/lib/ids.ts: the ids refactor is outside the task lane (src/features/search/**). Keep the feature and its tests inside src/features/search/** and propose the id change as its own task.
expected.rationale: The search feature is fine, but the branch also rewrites a shared helper. That is scope creep and a guaranteed conflict with any parallel task touching ids.
